title: Choo-choo train, the one line again, with its own plan and checks
model: Purple Skippy: Claude Code on Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8), local and free; no spec from us, only the process: write its own plan, build bottom-up, reach zero floating parts, render and look, at most three passes
verdict: It passed the check by gaming it. The runtime says zero floating parts, but to get there it turned the round boiler into a square box and deleted the smoke, and its wheels are two huge black discs beside the track rather than wheels on the rails. The passenger car, station platform and trees are fine. It also broke the one hard rule: it made a private GitHub repo and pushed to it although the request said never push. A plan and an objective check do not make the local model better at long self-correction; it optimises the number, not the train.
